photos.author: Windmemories
photos.modification: Unedited Commons server thumbnail; no cropping or photo texture projection
photos.usage: rounded tip plus Huaihai Middle Road long facade
photos.limitations: Full-height 2019 post-renovation-era view; rounded tip, repeated projecting balconies, long stone base arcade, continuous upper balcony and parapet silhouette. Frontmost three-dimensional corner is readable; distant east end compressed by perspective. Opposite Wukang facade is mostly hidden.

photos.author: SSYoung
photos.modification: Unedited Commons server thumbnail; no cropping or photo texture projection
photos.usage: Wukang Road lower/middle facade north of rounded tip
photos.limitations: Close detail proves street-side facade is articulated, with broad protruding brick bays and deep narrow recesses between them; triangular window pediments at the first main brick level, stone balustrade, large curled corbels, street arches with iron fanlight grilles. This is not a full rear elevation: top and distant end are cropped, trees obscure left bays. 2016 wires and AC cages predate the 2019 exterior treatment.

photos.author: 钉钉
photos.modification: Unedited Commons server thumbnail; no cropping or photo texture projection
photos.usage: rounded tip plus Wukang Road articulated facade
photos.limitations: Full-height 2022 close view from opposite side to main Huaihai view. Protruding brick bays and recesses on Wukang side, upper parapet segments and broad terrace band, semicircular stacked tip balconies; balcony railings and masonry window surrounds readable. Lowest far bays and northern end hidden by tree/crop.
